大日本帝國統計年鑑 1938

496 tables · 318,996 cells · LLM-transcribed · JSON · Excel

大日本帝國統計年鑑 1938

Dai Nippon Teikoku tōkei nenkan (Statistical Yearbook of the Empire of Japan), 第五十七回 (No. 57), 昭和十三年版 (Shōwa 13 edition)
內閣統計局, 東京 (昭和十三年版)

All 451 numbered tables and the 40 international tables are transcribed, with the unnumbered sub-tables printed beside them and the front-matter tables of weights and measures and of currency parities and exchange rates (from the volume's front-matter scan); the contents, the index, the page of charts and the bureau's list of publications are not. The page images are two-page spreads about 2,000 px wide, so the small type was read from enlarged crops. Tables printed across both pages of a spread are joined into one, and long tables read in sections by different readers are joined; where a table is printed as successive column blocks (tables 13 and 77), each block is a separate part. Printed totals were re-added by the readers: totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted (many differ by one or two units of rounding in thousand-yen figures). Where a digit was ambiguous only between 3 and 8 and exactly one reading made a printed total reconcile, that reading is used and noted. Where the print uses a full stop or a space for a thousands comma, or drops a decimal point, the reader's reading is noted in the table. The volume's errata slip (正誤表, 21 corrections) is attached as a note to each table it concerns; the figures stay as printed. About 120 of some 248,000 figure cells could not be read and are marked [?]; a literal ? printed in the book is kept as ?. A spot check, in which a second model re-transcribed three tables (1,196 figures) independently, agreed on every figure. Scan links open the page image in the Hitotsubashi database; please credit that database when using these transcriptions.
